name: search_web_images
description: Search web images from multiple sources in parallel, with unified ranking, deduplication, and safety review.

count.description: Required. Exact number of images to return. Must match the number the user asked for; do not treat the configured cap as the default.

preview.description: When terminal image printing is enabled, download the images and preview them with chafa.

preview_count.description: Maximum number of images to preview with chafa.

safe_search.description: Enable safe image search. Defaults to the plugin configuration.
